Metadata.title: Go Flow
Metadata.description: Discover cultures, live the Flow! Learn about the culture, curiosities and places of each destination before you travel.

Destinations.title: Featured destinations
Destinations.subtitle: Culture, curiosities and must-see places around the world

who.title: Who are we?
who.alt: A beach chair on a lake
paragraphs: We are a platform for people who want to truly know a destination before they even get there. We bring together the culture, curiosities and must-see places of each city in one place.

mission.title: Our mission
paragraphs: Travel is more than visiting landmarks — it's understanding local customs, tasting traditional food and connecting with the people who live there.
Our mission is to help you arrive prepared: knowing how to behave, what to try and what makes each destination unique.

values.title: Our values
values.alt: A city lit up at night
paragraphs: Authenticity, curiosity and respect. We value sourced information, tips from people who have been there and travel that respects the cultures and the environment of each destination.

FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Here are some of the most common questions about Go Flow

what.question: What is Go Flow?
what.answer: A platform to discover destinations through what makes them special: culture, customs, curiosities, traditional food and the places worth visiting.

planning.question: How does Go Flow help me plan my trip?
planning.answer: For each destination you'll find local etiquette tips, useful phrases, the best time to go, attractions, restaurants and places to stay — all on a single page.

sources.question: Where does the information come from?
sources.answer: From open, reliable sources such as Wikipedia, Wikivoyage and OpenStreetMap, always credited, plus tips from our community of travelers.

price.question: Do I have to pay to use Go Flow?

coverage.question: Which destinations are available?
coverage.answer: The goal is to cover cities all over the world. We start with the most popular destinations and keep expanding the list.

booking.question: Can I book hotels and tours on the platform?
booking.answer: We recommend them, and you book directly on well-known partner websites, under their own terms and security.

account.question: Do I need an account?
account.answer: Not to explore. With an account you'll be able to save favorite destinations, build itineraries and contribute reviews and tips.

contribute.question: Can I share tips?
contribute.answer: Yes! Travelers will be able to share tips and curiosities about places they know, and the community votes for the most helpful ones.
